payout_quote: Deposit at least $2,000 in new money within 15 days of account opening and maintain an average daily balance during the first 90 days: $100 bonus for $2,000+, $400 for $10,000+, $750 for $15,000+; earn an additional $100 when you open and activate a Merchant Services Clover account or Payroll Services within the first 90 days.
payout_value_note: tiered: $100/$400/$750 by average-daily-balance band plus optional $100 Clover/Payroll activation
biggest_catch: Tiers require maintaining the average daily balance for the full first 90 days — dipping below your target band drops you to a lower tier; only new money (not previously held at Golden 1) qualifies.
catches: Must open by September 30, 2026 — offer expires soon.
Bonus tiers are based on average daily balance maintained for the full first 90 days; dipping below resets eligibility for that tier.
New money only: funds currently or previously held at Golden 1 do not qualify.
Limited to new Golden 1 Sole Proprietor or Business Checking account holders; one bonus per member per business tax ID.
Cannot be combined with any other checking account bonus offer; Golden 1 may change or discontinue the offer at any time.
Account must remain open and in good standing through the bonus deposit (within 30 days after the 90-day qualification period).
Bonus reported as income to tax authorities as required by law; recipient responsible for taxes.
$8 monthly fee waived only with eStatements-only delivery and a $1,000 minimum average daily balance during the statement period.
eligibility: New Golden 1 Sole Proprietor or Business Checking account holders (California-based credit union; membership and business eligibility requirements apply) who can deposit at least $2,000 in new money within 15 days of opening.
numeric_basis: payout from official Golden 1 bonus terms (tiered $100-$750 + optional $100); time: account opening + deposit + optional Clover activation, est. 45-90 min active
timing: Open by September 30, 2026; deposit new money within 15 days; maintain balance tier for the first 90 days; bonus deposited within 30 days after the 90-day qualification period.
steps: Open a new Golden 1 Sole Proprietor or Business Checking account by September 30, 2026 (minimum $100 opening deposit).
Deposit at least $2,000 in new money within 15 days of account opening.
Maintain the target average daily balance for the full first 90 days: $2,000+ for $100, $10,000+ for $400, $15,000+ for $750.
Optionally open and activate a Merchant Services Clover account (or Payroll Services) within the 90-day qualification period for an extra $100.
Bonus is deposited into the Business Checking account within 30 days after the 90-day qualification period; keep the account open and in good standing.
